recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓抹片中，有核細胞絕大多數為大小一致、核質比高、染色質細緻、無顆粒的母細胞，成熟顆粒球與紅系前驅細胞極少，並有許多破碎細胞（smudge cells）；母細胞明顯超過 20%，符合急性白血病，系別需靠細胞化學與流式判定。
features: Nucleated cells dominated by a monotonous population of intermediate-sized blasts (approximately 90%)
High N:C ratio with scant agranular pale-blue cytoplasm and fine chromatin
Slightly irregular or angulated nuclear contours
Rare residual neutrophils and small lymphocytes; erythroid precursors sparse
Numerous smudged cells and scattered platelets in the background; no Auer rods evident at this power
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows a cellular specimen in which the vast majority of nucleated cells are monotonous intermediate-sized blasts with high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, slightly irregular nuclear contours, and scant agranular cytoplasm. Residual granulocytes, erythroid precursors, and lymphocytes are rare, and numerous smudged cells are present. Auer rods are not evident at this magnification. The blast proportion far exceeds 20%, establishing acute leukemia; with negative MPO and NSE cytochemistry and no lineage-specific markers on flow cytometry, the findings are consistent with acute undifferentiated leukemia.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts can look identical and are also MPO/NSE negative, but flow cytometry shows B- or T-lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 is MPO negative cytochemically but expresses myeloid antigens such as CD13, CD33, or CD117.
Megakaryoblasts may show cytoplasmic blebbing and express CD41/CD61, often with a dry tap from fibrosis.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with smudge cells
ddx.vs: CLL smudge cells occur with small mature lymphocytes having coarse clumped chromatin, not the fine chromatin of these blasts.
